newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - June 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - June 9.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - Trade volume between Hong Kong and Shanghai has increased by 25 percent each year since the start of 1990s with turnover hitting $3.64 billion in 1996.
- The State Information Centre said in a research paper that China's economy has entered a new round of healthy development this year with economic growth rate high and inflation low.
- BUSINESS NEWS - Experts believe Hong Kong will retain its position as an international finance centre after China takes over the British colony on July 1.
- A recent research paper by the China Acadamy of Social Sciences predicts China's economy will grow by around 10 percent this year with consumer price inflation at a year-on-year seven percent.
